settings.title: A Healthier Stool. You're Welcome.
settings.text: Most Americans get less than half the fiber they need daily, and their guts show it. Tiiga delivers 5g of raw, unprocessed baobab prebiotic fiber per serving, the kind that bulks stool naturally, feeds your colon, and keeps your digestive rhythm consistent. No laxatives, no harsh stimulants. Just fiber doing what fiber was always meant to do.

settings.title: Your Microbiome Will Thrive.
settings.text: Your gut is home to over 100 trillion microorganisms, and what you feed them determines everything. Studies have shown that baobab fruit fiber significantly increases populations of Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium, two of the most important beneficial bacteria in the human gut. More good bacteria means better digestion, less gas, and a gut ecosystem that actually works for you.

settings.title: Hydration That Actually Works.
settings.text: Water hydrates your mouth. Electrolytes hydrate your cells. Tiiga combines coconut water powder, naturally rich in potassium, with a full electrolyte blend to restore fluid balance at a deeper level. Research shows that potassium and sodium work together to regulate cellular hydration far more effectively than water alone, making every sip of Tiiga count for more.

settings.title: Bloating Starts in Your Gut.
settings.text: Bloating usually comes down to what is happening in your gut, not just what you ate for lunch. Baobab is one of the richest natural sources of polyphenols on the planet, and Tiiga pairs them with 5g of prebiotic fiber to support a balanced microbiome and healthy digestion.

settings.title: A Habit That Sticks.
settings.text: The best supplement is the one you actually take. Tiiga was built to be something you look forward to. Smooth, fruity, and satisfying enough to replace whatever you're already drinking in the morning. No chalky texture, no weird aftertaste, no forcing it down. Just a daily ritual that quietly transforms your gut, one stick at a time.
